content.text:
The entire.io CLI was already installed (version 0.11.3), so I skipped the install. I then enabled it in this repository with `entire enable -y --agent claude-code`.

The enable step installed 8 hooks for Claude Code and wrote the project config to `.entire/settings.json`. It also reported importable history for one agent, which you can pull in with `entire import <agent>`. I didn't run that.

Output of `entire status`:

```
● Enabled · branch main
  Agents · Claude Code
  Checkpoints sync to: origin
Agents: run `entire agent-help` for machine-readable usage.
```
